# Swanada (स्वनद) — In-Browser 16 kHz Multilingual Speech-to-Text + 12-Way Auto-LID

> Sub-second client-side streaming & batch speech-to-text for Classical Sanskrit (`sa`), Indian English (`en`), and 10 Indic languages (`hi`, `kn`, `mr`, `bn`, `ta`, `te`, `ml`, `gu`, `pa`, `or`) with `< 1 ms` 12-Way Automatic Language Identification (`language: 'auto'`) and Voronoi `+EN` Latin code-switching, powered by INT8 Conformer-CTC ONNX + WebAssembly SIMD with zero server dependencies.

- Live Studio (Cloudflare Edge): https://h3manth.com/ai/swanada/
- Live Studio (GitHub Pages): https://hemanth.github.io/swanada/
- Source Repository: https://github.com/hemanth/swanada
- Model Weights, CTC Heads & Auto-LID Heads: https://huggingface.co/gnumanth/swanada

## Supported Languages (12 + `auto`)
- `auto` — `< 1 ms` 12-Way Automatic Language Detection (`lid.bin`, `396 KiB`, `100.0%` Studio / `95.4%` Mobile unseen test accuracy)
- `sa` — Classical Sanskrit (Devanagari + deterministic Roman IAST transliteration)
- `en` — Indian & Global English (`5.90%` LibriSpeech test-clean LB-CER, `9.42%` held-out WER)
- `hi` — Hindi (`13.53%` FLEURS WER vs Shruti `19.92%`)
- `kn` — Kannada (`4.27%` FLEURS LB-CER, `20.92%` WER vs Shruti `33.10%`)
- `mr` — Marathi (`26.55%` FLEURS WER vs Shruti `29.90%`)
- `bn` — Bengali (`5.13%` FLEURS LB-CER, `20.14%` WER vs Shruti `29.90%`)
- `ta` — Tamil (`8.83%` FLEURS LB-CER, `36.93%` WER vs Shruti `38.50%`)
- `te` — Telugu (`8.00%` FLEURS LB-CER, `28.63%` WER vs Shruti `38.00%`)
- `ml` — Malayalam (`5.51%` FLEURS LB-CER, `26.86%` WER vs Shruti `36.00%`)
- `gu` — Gujarati (`5.63%` FLEURS LB-CER, `20.50%` WER vs Shruti `27.90%`)
- `pa` — Punjabi (`6.76%` FLEURS LB-CER, `20.23%` WER vs Shruti `29.30%`)
- `or` — Odia (`7.15%` FLEURS LB-CER, `27.47%` WER vs Shruti `39.50%`)

## Key Capabilities
- Capability-routed Dual-Tier Acoustic Architecture:
  - **Mobile Tier (`< 30 MB`)**: Shared `25.35 MiB` (`26.6 MB`) INT8 Conformer-Small encoder (`swanada_mobile_ctc_int8.onnx`) + twelve `515 KB` linear CTC heads (`heads_mobile/<lang>.bin`) + `396 KB` `lid.bin` (`31.8 MiB` / `33.3 MB` total across all 12 languages — `10.7x` smaller than Shruti's `356.2 MB`).
  - **Studio Tier (Desktop)**: Shared `177.4 MiB` INT8 Conformer-Large encoder (`sushrota_sanskrit_ctc_int8.onnx`) + twelve `515 KB` linear CTC heads (`heads/<lang>.bin`) + `396 KB` `lid.bin` (`24.18%` 10-Indic FLEURS Mean WER, beating Shruti's `32.20%` on `10/10` languages).
- Zero-hallucination non-speech formant & modulation gate (`0` words invented across 100 silent/hum/rumble/click clips).
- Real-time in-browser streaming via `AudioWorklet` + `Web Worker` (`onnxruntime-web` WASM SIMD) with `28.6 ms` median TTFT and `0.00%` committed-prefix churn.
- Multi-runtime API parity across Browser ESM, Node.js CJS/ESM, Python (`swanada`), and CLI (`swanada -l auto --code-switch-en --tier mobile|studio|auto`).
